title: People’s Mañanera November 26
author: Pedro Gellert
content:
_Every day, President Claudia Sheinbaum gives a morning presidential press
conference and Mexico Solidarity Media posts English language summaries,
translated by Mexico Solidarity 's Pedro Gellert. Previous press conference
summaries are available [here](https://mexicosolidarity.com/mananera/)._

**President to Send Family Justice Reform Bill to Congress  
** “It’s about protecting children and women,” President Claudia Sheinbaum
explained. The bill amends the National Code of Civil and Family Proceedings
and provides for 24-hour protection against vicarious violence.

**Sheinbaum Reminds the PAN That It Approved the Rules It Now Rejects  
** “It is false that there is overrepresentation,” the President responded
after Ricardo Anaya said that the PAN might not run in 2027 if the National
Electoral Institute (INE) maintains the party-based allocation of proportional
representation seats. Sheinbaum pointed out that the PAN, PRI, MC, and PRD
approved those rules, which were applied in 2015, 2018, 2021, and 2024.
Regarding the INE presidency, she asked, “How can you file a complaint and
then want the process to continue? And what happened to the complaint?” She
reiterated that the appointment of the new INE president is the responsibility
of Congress and that the Court’s ruling must first be heard to determine how
the process will proceed.

**Lie Detector**

  * It is not true that during her participation in the Asia Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit, President Claudia Sheinbaum only secured a panda, without reaching any agreements with China.
  * It is not true that a measure was approved requiring businesses to pay higher taxes in 2027.
  * It is not true that the Mexican government is “blindly” vaccinating against measles and “does not know where the unvaccinated communities are.”
  * It is not true that funding for school equipment and Well-Being University was cut.
  * It is not true that the federal government concealed the process of purchasing a fleet of trains.
  * It is not true that Energy Secretary Luz Elena González “has favored a businessman” by awarding him a multimillion-dollar contract.
